name: power
title: Battery & Power
description: Battery level and time remaining, plus measured power draw and culprits when the optional power watcher is installed.
author: pal

settings.label: Show on battery below
settings.description: Hide the bar item while discharging at or above this level, unless the power watcher has a warning or reports a high draw.

settings.label: Show while charging below
settings.description: Hide the bar item on external power above this level.

settings.label: Show draw above
settings.description: While on battery, show when the optional power watcher measures at least this many watts.

settings.label: Always show battery
settings.text: Keep the battery item visible even when it is healthy.

settings.label: Power watcher state
settings.description: Optional state.json written by the `power` watcher. It adds measured draw, warnings and top consumers; a stale file is ignored.

store.tagline: Battery level, remaining time, and what is drawing it
features: Battery percentage, source, state and time remaining from macOS `pmset` or Linux `upower`
Optional measured draw, warnings, wake locks and top consumers from the existing `power` watcher state file
The bar stays quiet while healthy by default, then returns for a low battery, a warning, or unusual draw on battery
Click opens Battery settings; hover opens a compact explanation of level, draw, warnings and consumers
